alerts.title: NH44 Jammu-Srinagar Highway shut for 4th straight day; 600+ vehicles stranded
alerts.summary: Fresh landslides between Jakheni and Chenani in Udhampur district have kept the 270km Jammu-Srinagar National Highway (NH44) — the only all-weather road link to the Valley — closed for a fourth consecutive day. Over 600 vehicles remain stranded across Nagrota, Reasi, Chenani, Patnitop, Doda, Ramban and Banihal, with no movement permitted. Jammu division schools have been ordered shut through Aug 30 over flood risk.
alerts.impact: Direct FM/LM stoppage: Srinagar, Baramulla, Anantnag hub linehaul via NH44 is fully blocked — expect severe TAT breaches and rising non-adherence for all Kashmir Valley pincodes. Flag Valley pincodes non-serviceable (NS) until NHAI confirms reopening; pre-build 5+ days buffer stock at Jammu hub for onward dispatch once cleared.

alerts.title: 230+ roads shut in Himachal, 118 in Uttarakhand as monsoon rain intensifies
alerts.summary: A landslide blocked Shimla's Cart Road as heavy rain shut over 230 roads across Himachal Pradesh, with orange alert in 4 districts and ~250 power transformers and 90 water schemes disrupted. Uttarakhand has 118 roads blocked including the Yamunotri National Highway.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — hill states: Expect route diversions and multi-day delays for Shimla, Manali, Dehradun, Rishikesh and Yamunotri-belt pincodes. Hold NS flags for cut-off talukas; build extra transit buffer for hill-state LM partners (Delhivery/Shadowfax) through early August as monsoon continues.

alerts.title: IMD extends J&K flash-flood warning to Aug 5 after 25+ deaths from cloudbursts
alerts.summary: Following cloudbursts and flash floods that killed 25+ across Poonch, Rajouri and Doda in mid-July, the Meteorological Centre has extended its wet-weather and flash-flood/landslide warning for the Jammu division through August 5, with brief torrential spells still expected through Aug 1-2 and again Aug 3-5.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Jammu region: Sustained rain window through Aug 5 keeps Poonch/Rajouri/Doda and connecting NH44 feeder roads at high washout risk. Maintain rolling NS flags and re-check daily rather than lifting after a single dry day.

alerts.title: Assam floods: death toll rises to 75, 3.32 lakh people affected across 7 districts
alerts.summary: Assam's flood toll has risen to 75 with 3.32 lakh people affected across Sivasagar, Charaideo, Golaghat, Jorhat, Nagaon, Sonitpur and Kamrup (Metro); 622 villages remain inundated and 45,000+ hectares of cropland submerged, though the overall situation is improving as waters recede.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Northeast: Keep NS flags active for worst-hit pincodes in the 7 affected districts; monitor Guwahati hub inbound linehaul for continued delay as waters recede over the coming week before lifting restrictions.

alerts.title: Nagaland landslides cut Dimapur-Kohima road; state runs chopper service
alerts.summary: Heavy rain in Mon, Mokokchung and Wokha districts triggered landslides that cut the Dimapur-Kohima road, prompting Nagaland to launch a helicopter service for stranded commuters; the same rain is worsening downstream flooding in neighboring Assam.
alerts.impact: Watch list: Kohima/Dimapur-linked hill routes remain at recurring landslide risk through August. Keep alternate NE routing on standby via Delhivery/Xpressbees and relax SLA penalties for affected pincodes during active rain spells.

alerts.title: South India truckers' indefinite strike over VLTD mandate set to begin Aug 1 — 2 days out
alerts.summary: Truck owners' associations across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Puducherry remain on track for an indefinite strike from August 1 over mandatory Vehicle Location Tracking Devices (VLTDs), panic buttons, and rising toll/compliance costs. No resolution reported as of Jul 29; talks continue.
alerts.impact: Expand LM with 3P, act now: With 2 days to the deadline, pre-position 5-7 days of buffer inventory at Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Coimbatore hubs, line up alternate LM partners for last-mile continuity, and finalize SLA-relaxation comms for southern pincodes ahead of Aug 1.

alerts.title: Kanwar Yatra 2026 underway: HTV bans live on Delhi-Haridwar corridor, full ban from Aug 4
alerts.summary: The Kanwar Yatra began Jul 30 and runs through Aug 11, with restrictions live until Aug 12. Heavy transport vehicles are already barred on Wazirabad Road, GT Road, Vikas Marg and several Delhi-UP border points (Maharajpur, Apsara, Seemapuri, Bhopura, Loni, Sonia Vihar); the Delhi-Haridwar Highway and Ganga Canal road go to a full vehicle ban Aug 4-12.
alerts.impact: Expand LM with 3P / reduce non-adherence: Reroute FM/LM linehaul away from Wazirabad Rd, GT Road, Vikas Marg and named UP border crossings now; plan alternate routing via NH-9/NH-44 for Delhi-Haridwar-Muzaffarnagar-Meerut corridor before the Aug 4 full ban, and pre-brief 3P partners on the Aug 4-12 blackout window.

alerts.title: Mumbai-Pune corridor: rain-hit expressway & rail slow JNPA cargo movement
alerts.summary: Landslides and flooding along the Mumbai-Pune Expressway and the old NH have slowed truck movement between western India's manufacturing hubs and Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPA), with rain also disrupting rail connectivity in the region.
alerts.impact: Watch list: Karjat-Lonavala ghat section remains a recurring bottleneck for Mumbai-Pune linehaul. Build extra transit buffer for Pune/Navi Mumbai hub dispatches and monitor for repeat closures through August.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel steady at multi-city highs despite lower crude; LPG flat this cycle
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged since OMCs' May 25 hike, holding at elevated levels — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20 per litre (petrol/diesel), Mumbai ₹111.21/₹99.82 — even as crude eased on hopes of Strait of Hormuz shipping resuming after the US-Iran standoff. LPG, CNG and PNG remain unchanged for over a month.
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no action yet: No immediate LM/FM disruption, but sustained high fuel levels keep pressure on 3P per-km rates. Track weekly for early signal on Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees fuel surcharge asks ahead of next pricing cycle.
